items.title: Kristen Korb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000
items.q: he used to do that with Ella Fitzgerald

ctx.x: How did your CD with Ray come about?

That lesson with Ray. Out of that, yeah. I just said this is what I want to do. And I wasn’t asking him to help me necessarily, I just wanted to know am I good enough, and if so, who do I need to talk to. Because education is a real strong part of my family. I come from a family of teachers — not music-wise necessarily — but a lot of elementary school teachers and administrators and I know that teaching is a part of who I am. And I enjoy passing along the information. But I want to play. And at the same time if…
